text:
Which statement about the Periodic Table is correct?
A
The elements are arranged in order of increasing relative atomic mass.
B
The reactivity of the elements in Group I and in Group VII increases as the groups are
descended.
C
Elements in the same period have similar chemical properties.
D
Elements in Group II form ions with a 2+ charge.
